nameEn: Manufacture of steam generators, except central heating hot water boilers
description: This class includes the manufacture of steam or other vapour generating boilers and nuclear reactors.
includes: manufacture of steam or other vapour generating boilers
manufacture of auxiliary plant for use with steam generators: condensers, economisers, superheaters, steam collectors and accumulators
manufacture of nuclear reactors, except isotope separators
manufacture of parts for marine or power boilers
pipe system construction comprising further processing of tubes generally to make pressure vessels, main-line pipelines, distribution networks, steam pipelines
excludes: manufacture of central heating boilers and radiators, see 2521
manufacture of boiler-turbine sets (turbines + connected boilers), see 2811
manufacture of instantaneous or storage water heaters, see 2750
